Agent Name: Cubing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the constraints and prematurely excluded green from consideration. “All green corners” and “all green that borders yellow” being found does not cover the green-white edge. A full enumeration shows every edge mentioned is accounted for except Green–White, so the removed edge should be Green, White. The expert failed to systematically mark which of the 12 edges were covered by the given findings and incorrectly concluded Red, White.
